description: This file defines the LocationService class, a final class that manages device location updates and authorization status using CoreLocation. It provides methods for requesting location, starting/stopping updates, and handling significant location changes, implementing CLLocationManagerDelegate.

classes.name: LocationService
classes.description: Manages device location updates and authorization using CoreLocation, providing async APIs for location retrieval and change monitoring.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Requests and ensures the app has the specified location authorization mode (when in use or always).

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current location with specified parameters, including accuracy, max age, and timeout.

methods.name: startLocationUpdates
methods.description: Starts streaming location updates with a specified desired accuracy and option for significant change monitoring, returning an AsyncStream of locations.

methods.name: stopLocationUpdates
methods.description: Stops ongoing location updates and significant change monitoring.

methods.name: startMonitoringSignificantLocationChanges
methods.description: Begins monitoring significant location changes with a callback for location updates.
